Name: TypeOfPopulationGroup
Description: A generic element for specifying a reason for a PopulationGroup. Note that this element can contain either a term from a controlled vocabulary list or a textual description.

Name: Label
Description: A display label for the PopulationGroup.

Name: Description
Description: A description of the content and purpose of the PopulationGroup.

Name: GroupingUniverseReference
Description: Reference to the universe statement describing the persons or other objects to which the contents of this group pertain. This is not a university contained by the group but one that helps define the purpose and application of the group.

Name: GroupingConceptReference
Description: Reference to the concept expressed by the objects in this group. This helps define the context within which this PopulationGroup is relevant.

Name: Subject
Description: If subjects are listed for this group, it is strongly recommended that the subjects listed also be found in the TopicalCoverage element for the parent packaging element when this group is included directly or by reference in a module containing a coverage element. Use of subject at the group level allows for associating objects as a type of subject based group or to identify subject characteristics of a reusable group of objects.

Name: Keyword
Description: If keywords are listed for this group, it is strongly recommended that the keywords listed also be found in the TopicalCoverage element for the parent packaging element when this group is included directly or by reference in a module containing a coverage element. Use of keyword at the group level allows for associating objects as a type of keyword based group or to identify keyword characteristics of a reusable group of objects.

Name: PopulationReference
Description: Reference to a constituent Population. TypeOfObject should be set to Population.

Name: PopulationGroupReference
Description: Reference to constituent PopulationGroup. This allows for nesting of PopulationGroups. TypeOfObject should be set to PopulationGroup.

Name: IsOrdered
Description: If set to "true" indicates that the content of the group is ordered.
